title: Ingoro y'Ibirahuri vy'Indorerwamo
intro: Iyumvire igihugu ca kure c’ubutunzi n’ubwiza aho basenga izuba aho gusenga Umuremyi waryo. Ikete rirashika rifise umuhamagaro udashobora kwirengagizwa, urugendo ruratangura ruja ku rusengero runini kuruta urwo ari rwo rwose rwabonetse mbere. Aho, ukwihenda kuzoshirwa ahabona n’ivu rihenda amaso, kandi akanya k’ugusobanuka kazohindura vyose.
clues: Natwaye igihugu giteye imbere abantu baco bapfukamira izuba aho gupfukamira Allah.
Naronse ikete ryiza rimpamagaye ko ntakwishira hejuru ahubwo ngo nze mu kwiyorosha kuri Allah.
Naciye ngira inama inama yanje maze nca mpitamwo ubudiplomate ubwa mbere, nrungika ingabirano kugira ngo ngerageze uwuyirungitse.
Naje kwa Sulaymani, intebe yanje bwite iranyerekwa yiyoberanije kugira ngo bagerageze ko nemera.
Naciye ninjira mu ngoro ndende cane, hasi hayo hari ibirahuri vyoroshe, nari nihenda ko ari amazi maremare.
Namenyesheje ukuyobokera kwanje ndi kumwe na Sulaymani kuri Allah, Umukama w’isi.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu binogo vy'ikiyaga .
Yakubiswe n’imyaka myinshi y’indwara n’ugutakaza umuryango .
Yategetswe gutanga umwana akundwa mu ndoto .
Yageragejwe n'intebe y'ubwami yiyoberanije be n'ingoro y'ibirahuri
Bajugunywa mu muriro ururumba kubera gumena ibigirwamana .
trial.answer: Yageragejwe n'intebe y'ubwami yiyoberanije be n'ingoro y'ibirahuri

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yagumye mu kutizera maze aratikizwa hamwe n'abantu banje .
Yayobokeye hamwe na Sulaymani kuri Allah, Umukama w'isi
Yarohamye mu kiyaga mu gihe yariko akurikira abemera .
outcome.answer: Yayobokeye hamwe na Sulaymani kuri Allah, Umukama w'isi

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
